messages:
sylvie: getting a small but visible uptick in TLS alerts for eu-west -> na-west services since 04:12 UTC. looks like client cert verification errors. any recent RBAC/key changes?
marc: saw a couple RBAC PRs touching keystore owners last night (infra/rbac#889 and infra/rbac#904). will pull diffs.
anika: quick grep in proxy logs shows `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` for dynamically provisioned mTLS certs; cert-issuer logs show `kms:Decrypt denied` when trying to unwrap CA key. excerpt: 
```
2026-04-07T04:11:58Z cert-issuer ERROR: unwrap failed: PermissionDenied: iam:deny for principal=serviceAccount:ca-operator@infra
```
hsm-bot: noticed update: keyring ingress-hsm had IAM binding change at 2026-04-07T01:04:12Z (author=infra-sweep). removed group binding that transitively permitted ca-operator.
sylvie: ok this smells like RBAC -> KMS fallout. can we add a targeted binding for the ca-operator SA and restore traffic quickly?
marc: yes, prefer narrow patch: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ca-key --location=eu-west1 --keyring=ingress-hsm --member=serviceAccount:ca-operator@infra --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` applying now.
ops-bot: IAM binding applied (op:kb-3344) 04:18:03Z.
anika: cert-issuer retried and issued new certs at 04:20:01Z. handshake success returned by 04:21. small outage ~9 minutes.
sylvie: good. root cause timeline: RBAC sweep removed group binding -> key IAM lost effective principal -> ca-operator couldn't decrypt -> no certs -> mTLS fails.
marc: action items: 1) make `kms-impact-check` mandatory in infra-ci for any KMS IAM or RBAC change touching infra SAs, 2) add a pre-merge simulation that runs `iam:simulate` and a sandbox decrypt test as the affected SA, 3) add an alert that fires when KMS key `cryptoKeyDecrypter` bindings are removed from groups that own infra SAs.
sec-bot: also recommend tightening audit logs: forward Cloud KMS admin changes to security sink and run a weekly automation that checks for orphaned SAs that lost decrypt perms.
anika: small improvement: cert-issuer should fail closed with a clear alert linking to the RBAC PR that touched bindings in last 24h. we can tag PRs with `infra-impact` and show in the alert.
sylvie: i'm adding a short canary policy: any RBAC/key change that affects cert operators must roll to a single region for 30m with `certs_ok` health check before global roll. add automatic rollback if cert issuance failures > 3 in 5m.
marc: I'll open infra PR to add the CI hooks and the canary gating. referencing this incident in ticket SEC-2026-512. ticket: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-512
ops-bot: attached logs, key policy diff, and quick rollback snippet to SEC-2026-512. snippet: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:ca-operator@infra --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter`
sylvie: thanks all. let's also add a short runbook entry for oncall: how to check KMS denies, run `gcloud logging read` query, and apply temp binding. will follow up with PR to docs. closing after PRs created. :white_check_mark:
